title.zh: 先构造算子并得到谱的上界
title.en: Construct the operator and bound its spectrum

given.zh: h>0。乘积概率分布使每个 v(x)∈[−h,h] 几乎处处成立；ℤ² 可数，所以可同时要求所有坐标满足 |v(x)|≤h。
given.en: Assume h>0. Each coordinate lies in [−h,h] almost surely; countability of ℤ² gives a single full-measure event where |v(x)|≤h for every x.

claim.zh: Hᵥ 是有界自伴算子，‖Hᵥ‖≤4+h，因而 σ(Hᵥ)⊆[−4−h,4+h]⊂ℝ。
claim.en: Hᵥ is bounded and self-adjoint, with ‖Hᵥ‖≤4+h. Hence σ(Hᵥ)⊆[−4−h,4+h]⊂ℝ.

statement.zh: 对每个 x∈ℤ² 有 Pr(|v(x)|≤h)=1；可数交后，Pr(∀x, |v(x)|≤h)=1。
statement.en: For each x∈ℤ², Pr(|v(x)|≤h)=1; countable intersection gives Pr(∀x, |v(x)|≤h)=1.

reason.zh: 坐标服从 [−h,h] 上的均匀分布，而格点集合可数，因此可以在同一个满测度事件上同时控制所有坐标。
reason.en: Each coordinate is uniform on [−h,h], and the lattice is countable, so a single full-measure event controls all coordinates.

statement.zh: 令 Tₑu(x)=u(x+e)。‖Tₑu‖=‖u‖，Tₑ*=T₋ₑ；故四邻居和的范数≤4且自伴。
statement.en: Put Tₑu(x)=u(x+e). Then ‖Tₑu‖=‖u‖ and Tₑ*=T₋ₑ; the four-neighbor sum is self-adjoint with norm at most four.

reason.zh: 平移是 ℤ² 的双射，重排平方和保持范数；相反方向的平移配对后等于自己的伴随。
reason.en: Translation bijects ℤ² and preserves the squared sum. Pairing opposite shifts makes their sum equal to its adjoint.

statement.en: ‖Mᵥu‖²=Σₓ|v(x)u(x)|²≤h²Σₓ|u(x)|², hence ‖Mᵥ‖≤h.

reason.zh: 逐项使用 |v(x)|≤h；实值势又使乘法算子的伴随仍是它自己。
reason.en: Apply |v(x)|≤h termwise. Real-valued v also makes the multiplication operator self-adjoint.

statement.en: Hᵥ=ΣₑTₑ+Mᵥ and ‖Hᵥ‖≤4+h; λ∈σ(Hᵥ) implies λ∈ℝ and |λ|≤4+h.

reason.zh: 算子范数的三角不等式给出 4+h；自伴算子的谱为实数，且谱点模长不超过算子范数。
reason.en: The norm triangle inequality gives 4+h. A self-adjoint operator has real spectrum, with every spectral modulus bounded by its operator norm.

title.zh: 在同一个随机势中找到任意大的近常值方块
title.en: Find arbitrarily large nearly constant boxes in one configuration

given.zh: 给定 c∈[−h,h]、ε>0 和最小半边长 N，要求某个平移方块上的每个势值都满足 |v(x)−c|<ε。
given.en: Fix c∈[−h,h], ε>0 and a minimum half-side N. Seek a translated box on which every potential value satisfies |v(x)−c|<ε.

claim.zh: 几乎每个 v 同时满足：对所有 c、ε、N，都存在中心 a 和 n≥N，使 a+Bₙ 上 |v(x)−c|<ε。
claim.en: Almost every v has this property simultaneously for all c, ε and N: some a and n≥N satisfy |v(x)−c|<ε throughout a+Bₙ.

statement.en: p=length((c−ε,c+ε)∩[−h,h])/(2h)>0.

reason.zh: h>0、c∈[−h,h]、ε>0 保证交集具有正长度，包括 c 位于区间端点的情形。
reason.en: The assumptions h>0, c∈[−h,h] and ε>0 ensure positive intersection length, including when c is an endpoint.

statement.zh: 固定半边长 N，整个方块的命中概率为 q=p^((2N+1)²)>0。
statement.en: For half-side N, the probability that the whole box succeeds is q=p^((2N+1)²)>0.

reason.zh: 方块只有 (2N+1)² 个格点；各坐标独立，故联合概率是有限乘积。
reason.en: The box has (2N+1)² sites. Coordinate independence makes its success probability the finite product.

statement.zh: 选无限多个互不相交的平移方块；相应事件独立，且 Σᵢq=∞。
statement.en: Choose infinitely many disjoint translates; their events are independent and Σᵢq=∞.

reason.zh: 不同方块读取不相交的坐标，Borel–Cantelli 因而给出几乎处处有无穷多个命中方块。
reason.en: Disjoint boxes read disjoint coordinate sets. Borel–Cantelli therefore gives infinitely many successful boxes almost surely.

statement.zh: 先对 (c′,δ,N)∈ℚ×ℚ×ℕ、c′∈[−h,h]、δ>0 的全部条件取可数交。
statement.en: First take the countable intersection over (c′,δ,N)∈ℚ×ℚ×ℕ with c′∈[−h,h] and δ>0.

reason.zh: 每个条件都有满测度，指标集可数，所以取交后仍有满测度，不需要对全部实数中心直接取交。
reason.en: Each condition has full measure and the indexing set is countable, so the intersection retains full measure without intersecting over all real centers.

statement.en: For arbitrary c,ε, choose |c′−c|<ε/2 and 0<δ<ε/2. Then |v(x)−c|≤|v(x)−c′|+|c′−c|<ε.

reason.zh: 可在 [−h,h] 内选有理 c′ 逼近 c，再选有理 δ。前一行的同一个事件因此同时支持所有实数 c 和正容差。
reason.en: Choose rational c′ inside [−h,h] near c and a rational δ. The same event from the preceding line then handles every real c and positive tolerance.

title.zh: 把平面波截断，误差只留在边界
title.en: Truncate a plane wave so that only boundary error remains

given.zh: 对常势 c，取 λ∈[c−4,c+4]，令 α=arccos((λ−c)/4)。在 Bₙ 上设 uₙ(x)=exp(iα(x₁+x₂))/(2n+1)，方块外取 0。
given.en: For constant c and λ∈[c−4,c+4], set α=arccos((λ−c)/4). On Bₙ put uₙ(x)=exp(iα(x₁+x₂))/(2n+1), and put it equal to 0 outside.

claim.en: ‖uₙ‖=1. For n≥1 its squared residual is at most (16n+8)·((4+|c|+|λ|)/(2n+1))², so the residual tends to 0.

statement.en: Set α=arccos((λ−c)/4); then 4cos α+c=λ.

reason.zh: λ∈[c−4,c+4] 使 arccos 的参数位于 [−1,1]，所以 cos(arccos t)=t 可在此使用。
reason.en: The interval assumption places the argument in [−1,1], where cos(arccos t)=t applies.

reason.zh: 方块上的复指数模长均为一，方块外取零，因此平方范数就是格点数乘以归一化系数的平方。
reason.en: The complex exponentials have modulus one on the box and vanish outside it, so the squared norm is site count times the squared normalization factor.

statement.en: Before truncation, Σₑu(x+e)=(2eⁱᵅ+2e⁻ⁱᵅ)u(x)=4cos α·u(x).

reason.zh: 两个正方向各增加相位 α，两个负方向各减少 α。因此内部格点的 (H_c−λI)uₙ 恰好为零。
reason.en: Each positive direction adds α and each negative direction subtracts α. Consequently the residual (H_c−λI)uₙ vanishes at interior sites.

statement.zh: n≥1 时，残差支撑在 Bₙ₊₁∖Bₙ₋₁，点数 (2n+3)²−(2n−1)²=16n+8。
statement.en: For n≥1 the residual is supported in Bₙ₊₁∖Bₙ₋₁, with (2n+3)²−(2n−1)²=16n+8 sites.

reason.zh: 内部所有邻居仍在截断方块内；外部超过一层后所有相关坐标均为零。每点残差至多 (4+|c|+|λ|)/(2n+1)，平方求和后为 O(1/n)，从而残差趋零。
reason.en: Interior neighbors remain inside the truncation, and beyond one outer layer all relevant coordinates vanish. Each residual is bounded by (4+|c|+|λ|)/(2n+1); summing its square gives O(1/n), so the residual tends to zero.

title.zh: 把常势近似转移到随机势上
title.en: Transfer the constant-potential approximation to the random operator

given.zh: 取 n 足够大，且在 a+Bₙ 上 |v(x)−c|<ε/2。把上一步的单位向量平移到这个方块。
given.en: Choose n large enough and a box a+Bₙ where |v(x)−c|<ε/2. Translate the preceding unit vector to that box.

claim.zh: 得到单位向量 u，满足 ‖(Hᵥ−λI)u‖<ε。
claim.en: This gives a unit vector u with ‖(Hᵥ−λI)u‖<ε.

statement.zh: 把 uₙ 平移到 a+Bₙ 得 u；‖u‖=1，且 supp u⊆a+Bₙ。
statement.en: Translate uₙ to a+Bₙ to obtain u, with ‖u‖=1 and supp u⊆a+Bₙ.

reason.zh: 格点平移保持 ℓ² 范数，也保持常势算子的形式，故原来的常势残差界随向量一同平移。
reason.en: Lattice translation preserves the ℓ² norm and the constant-potential operator, so its residual estimate transfers with the vector.

statement.en: ‖(Hᵥ−H_c)u‖²=Σₓ∈a+Bₙ |v(x)−c|²|u(x)|²≤(ε/2)².

reason.zh: 两算子的平移项抵消，只剩乘法 v−c；方块上的误差界及 ‖u‖=1 控制整个平方和。
reason.en: The shift terms cancel, leaving multiplication by v−c. The box estimate and unit norm control the full squared sum.

statement.en: ‖(Hᵥ−λI)u‖≤‖(Hᵥ−H_c)u‖+‖(H_c−λI)u‖<ε/2+ε/2=ε.

reason.zh: 先用上一步把常势残差压到 ε/2 以下，再从同时成立的方块事件选取足够大的方块，使两类误差同时满足要求。
reason.en: First make the constant-potential residual strictly smaller than ε/2, then select a sufficiently large box from the simultaneous event to meet both error requirements.

title.zh: 用近似特征向量排除逆算子
title.en: Rule out an inverse using approximate eigenvectors

given.zh: 取任意 λ∈[−4−h,4+h]，令 c=max(−h,min(h,λ))。第 2 步的同时成立事件已经固定。
given.en: Fix any λ∈[−4−h,4+h] and put c=max(−h,min(h,λ)). Work on the simultaneous full-measure event from step 2.

statement.zh: c=max(−h,min(h,λ))：λ<−h 时 c=−h；−h≤λ≤h 时 c=λ；λ>h 时 c=h。
statement.en: For c=max(−h,min(h,λ)), one has c=−h if λ<−h, c=λ if −h≤λ≤h, and c=h if λ>h.

reason.zh: 这是截取公式的三个分支；结合 −4−h≤λ≤4+h，每一支都给出 c∈[−h,h] 和 |λ−c|≤4。
reason.en: These are the three branches of the clamp. Together with −4−h≤λ≤4+h, each yields c∈[−h,h] and |λ−c|≤4.

statement.zh: 令 εₖ=1/(k+1)，选方块容差 εₖ/2、半边长至少为 max(k,Nₖ)。
statement.en: Put εₖ=1/(k+1), and choose a box of tolerance εₖ/2 and half-side at least max(k,Nₖ).

reason.zh: Nₖ 是常势近似对误差 εₖ 要求的大小。方块事件同时允许任意最小大小与容差，因此这两项要求可共同实现。
reason.en: Nₖ is the size threshold for the constant-potential approximation at error εₖ. The box event permits any minimum size and tolerance, so both can be met together.

statement.en: Then ‖uₖ‖=1 and 0≤‖(Hᵥ−λI)uₖ‖<1/(k+1)→0.

reason.zh: 逐次应用方块扰动结论，残差被同一个趋零数列夹住，所以得到所需的近似特征向量序列。
reason.en: Apply the box perturbation result at each k. The residuals are squeezed by a sequence tending to zero, giving the approximate eigenvectors.

statement.zh: 若 R=(Hᵥ−λI)⁻¹ 有界，则 1=‖R(Hᵥ−λI)uₖ‖≤‖R‖/(k+1)→0，矛盾。
statement.en: If R=(Hᵥ−λI)⁻¹ were bounded, then 1=‖R(Hᵥ−λI)uₖ‖≤‖R‖/(k+1)→0, a contradiction.

reason.zh: 因此 Hᵥ−λI 不可逆，即 λ 在谱中；此结论适用于区间中的每个 λ。
reason.en: Thus Hᵥ−λI is not invertible, placing λ in the spectrum for every λ in the interval.

title.zh: 在满测度事件上合并两侧包含
title.en: Combine both inclusions on a full-measure event

given.zh: 势处处有界和所有近常值方块存在这两个事件均为满测度；它们的交仍为满测度。
given.en: The bounded-potential event and the simultaneous-box event both have full measure, and so does their intersection.

claim.zh: 几乎处处存在 Hᵥ，使 Hᵥ 满足给定格点公式、自伴，并且 σ(Hᵥ)={z∈ℂ: Im z=0，−4−h≤Re z≤4+h}。
claim.en: Almost surely there exists Hᵥ satisfying the lattice formula, self-adjointness and σ(Hᵥ)={z∈ℂ: Im z=0, −4−h≤Re z≤4+h}.

statement.en: Let E=E_bounded∩E_boxes; then Pr(E)=1.

reason.zh: 两个补集都为零测集，有限并仍为零测集，故可在同一个事件上同时使用两条证明支线。
reason.en: Both complements have measure zero, as does their union, so both proof branches hold on the same event.

statement.zh: 对 v∈E，用有界势构造同一个 Hᵥ，得到 σ(Hᵥ)⊆I_h 和 I_h⊆σ(Hᵥ)。
statement.en: For v∈E, construct one operator Hᵥ from the bounded potential, giving σ(Hᵥ)⊆I_h and I_h⊆σ(Hᵥ).

reason.zh: 第一条包含来自算子范数，第二条来自该配置的近常值方块；两者使用同一个格点算子。
reason.en: The first inclusion comes from the norm bound, the second from nearly constant boxes of that configuration; both concern the same lattice operator.

statement.en: σ(Hᵥ)=I_h={z:Im z=0, −4−h≤Re z≤4+h}.

reason.zh: 由集合双向包含得到相等，并保留构造时的格点公式与自伴性，装入原题的“几乎处处存在 H”结论。
reason.en: Two inclusions give set equality. Retain the lattice formula and self-adjointness from the construction to obtain the target almost-sure existence statement.
